strategy.overview: Atlantis uses three numbered target banks to qualify three locks. Hit the flashing 1 in each bank to light the first lock at the left ramp, then repeat the pattern for 2 and 3. Lock three balls at that ramp to start Multiball; the lower-left flip ramp is the single Jackpot shot.
strategy.simpleOverview: Hit the flashing 1 in all three target banks, then shoot the left ramp to lock a ball. Repeat with the flashing 2s and then 3s. The third lock starts Multiball. During Multiball, shoot the lower-left flip ramp for the Jackpot.
strategy.summary: Complete the flashing 1 across all three target banks and lock at the left ramp; repeat for 2 and 3. The third lock starts Multiball. Shoot the lower-left flip ramp for the single Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Light Lock 1
quickInfo.summary: Hit the flashing 1 in each of the three target banks.

quickInfo.name: Light later Locks
quickInfo.summary: Repeat across all three banks for the flashing 2s, then the flashing 3s.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Collect all three locks at the left ramp.

quickInfo.name: Collect Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the lower-left flip ramp during Multiball.

steps.text: Hit the flashing 1 in each of the three numbered target banks to light the first lock.
Shoot the left lock ramp, then complete the flashing 2 in all three banks and lock again.
Complete the flashing 3 across all three banks and shoot the left ramp for the third lock and Multiball start.
During Multiball, shoot the lower-left flip ramp for the Jackpot.

alternatives.title: Spot target progress
alternatives.when: Use these routes when one numbered target is unsafe or difficult.

steps.text: Shoot the upper-left saucer to spot one currently flashing numbered target.
Roll through an inlane, then make the lower-left flip ramp before its short timer expires to spot the whole current number set.
Finish the third numbered set with a controllable return whenever possible.
After the third lock serves the balls, separate them before attacking the lower-left flip ramp.
Treat the Jackpot as a single lit collect unless this machine's software clearly relights it.

machineSetup: Confirm whether the machine uses the original progressive Jackpot or a tournament ROM with a fixed value.
Check the center post, all nine numbered targets, upper-left saucer, inlanes, both left ramps, and three-ball lock assembly.

cautions.issue: Tournament ROMs can change the Jackpot from a progressive, carryover value to a fixed value.
cautions.response: Read the display and event notes before choosing a Jackpot-heavy strategy.
